title: 有馬記念の後に・稲妻は突然に

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap blows Super Creek out of the water in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, Tamamo Cross visits the waiting room and declares she's postponing competing for the Dream Trophy in order to face off against Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The appearance of an unexpected rival dampens Oguri Cap's victory and marks the start of a new period of training.
